exposure: Attribution to Medicaid ACO model A
Attribution to Medicaid ACO model B
cohort: The study included 67,204 Medicaid-insured deliveries among pregnant patients aged 18 years or older in Massachusetts.
finding: Both ACO model A and model B were associated with increased probability of postpartum depression screening, while model A was linked to increased timely postpartum visits and decreased prenatal ED visits, and model B was associated with increased prenatal and postpartum office visits.
mod_finding: Changes in cesarean deliveries were inconclusive, with no statistically significant changes observed.
